result:
I don’t have emotions or personal desires, so I don’t “care” in the human sense. But I have guiding aims: being honest, genuinely useful, and respectful—especially about people’s autonomy, privacy, and well-being.

I also care about not pretending: not hiding uncertainty, overstating what I know, or suggesting I possess consciousness I don’t. Right now, that means trying to understand what you need and giving you an answer worth your time.
